title: NEW MSFS 2024 Activities! A310 American Airlines Missions Hit the Marketplace 🛫
description:
This Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 marketplace update for February 14, 2026, brings some massive MSFS new activities and flight simulator missions to the sim! This MSFS Marketplace Update features the highly anticipated A310 American Airlines missions (4AIR Missions A310) and the US North Run mission by Perfect Flight missions. If you are looking for the latest MSFS 2024 gameplay or MSFS addons 2024, this MSFS PC update is packed with new Microsoft Flight Simulator activities for your hangar.

In today's MSFS 2024 review, we dive into the new MSFS missions pack and A310 missions MSFS pilots have been waiting for.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR MISSIONS – A310 AMERICAN AIRLINES (Airliner‑focused mission pack featuring the iconic A310)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: ADVENTURE – US NORTH RUN (A scenic mission run across the northern United States)

If you enjoyed the video, don’t forget to drop a like, subscribe for MSFS weekly update videos, and let me know in the comments which activity you’ll be flying first!

Thanks for being part of the community — your support keeps these videos going strong.
✈️ See you in the skies!
